recipeGroups.heading: Category 1

recipes.name: Option 1: Onion and Tomato slice salad
ingredients: ½ onion, thinly sliced (red onion works well for its mild flavor)
steps: Slice the tomatoes thinly and place them in a serving bowl. Peel and thinly slice the onion and add it to the bowl with the tomatoes.
Add salt as per your taste
Toss gently to coat the vegetables evenly.

recipes.name: Option 2: Cucumber and Onion salad
steps: Thinly slice the cucumbers and red onion.
In a large mixing bowl, combine the sliced cucumbers and red onions.
Add salt as per your taste.

recipes.name: Option 3: Radish and cucumber slice salad
steps: Wash the radish thoroughly. Trim off the ends of the radishes and thinly slice them. Peel the onion,wash thoroughly and slice them.
In a large mixing bowl, combine the sliced radishes and onion. Add the chopped fresh coriander leaves.
Season with salt to taste.
Gently toss the vegetables evenly .

recipes.name: Option 4: Tomato and cucumber slice salad
steps: Wash the Tomato and cucumber thoroughly. Slice the tomato.Peel the onion,wash thoroughly and slice them.
In a large mixing bowl, combine the sliced tomato and sliced cucumber. Add the chopped fresh coriander leaves.
Season with salt to taste.
Gently toss the vegetables evenly .

recipes.name: Option 5: CCC chop salad (Cucumber Capsicum Cabbage)
ingredients: ½ red bell pepper (capsicum), thinly chopped
steps: Wash the cucumber, red bell pepper, and cabbage thoroughly. Trim off the ends of the cucumber and chop it. Remove the seeds and membranes from the red bell pepper and thinly slice it. Thinly slice the cabbage.
In a large mixing bowl, combine the sliced cucumber, red bell pepper, and cabbage. Add the chopped fresh coriander leaves.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Gently toss the vegetables evenly.

recipes.name: Option 6: Mixed vegetable salad
ingredients: 1 bell pepper (capsicum), diced (any color you prefer)
1 cup mixed salad greens (such as lettuce, Cabbage), torn into bite-sized pieces
2 tablespoons fresh coriander leaves, chopped (optional, for garnish)
steps: Wash and dice the cucumber, tomato, and bell pepper. Grate the carrot. Thinly slice the red onion. Tear the salad greens into bite-sized pieces.
In a large mixing bowl, combine the diced cucumber, tomato, bell pepper, grated carrot, sliced red onion, and torn salad greens.
Season with salt to taste.
Gently toss to coat the vegetables evenly with the dressing.
If desired, sprinkle chopped fresh coriander leaves over the salad for garnish.

recipeGroups.heading: Salad Law
freeText: SALAD LAW
Daily intake for legumes should be 50 - 100 grams (boiled).
If you feel bloating issues, add more vegetables in your bowl.
Avoid adding beetroot, potato and tubers in vegetable bowls.
Add different varieties of vegetables in your bowl.
